description: hyp guards: write-once raw + journal fragments incl. a Bash mistake-net branch (PreToolUse), generic policy interpreter over operating-model policy nodes (PreToolUse), capture-intent context (UserPromptSubmit), standing rules + drift check + uncommitted-capture warning + stale-dashboard check + ledger resolver with open-decision surfacing (SessionStart), verdict-gated dispatch of the top open item + unjournaled-work backstop (Stop, dispatch at experiments profile), dashboard refresh (SessionStart + Stop), preflight gate on run-shaped commands + advisory commit backstop (PreToolUse, experiments profile), license-join advisory on rule-carrier writes — a rule write must cite a resolvable directive/incident license (PreToolUse, H-250 keep).

hooks.command:
c="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/license-join-corpus"; f="$c/../license-join-fires.log"; mkdir -p "$c" 2>/dev/null || true; ln -sfn "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(pwd)}" "$c/artifacts" 2>/dev/null || true; out=$(python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/scripts/license-join-check.py" --corpus "$c" 2>/dev/null) || true; if [ -n "$out" ]; then echo "$out"; touch "$f" 2>/dev/null || true; printf '%s
' "$out" | grep '^RULE-LICENSE' | sed "s|^|$(date -u +%FT%TZ) |" >> "$f" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; exit 0
python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/compile-dashboard.py" --check || echo "hyp: DASHBOARD.md was stale at session start (the next hook refreshes it) — review and commit the refreshed copy."
